title: "Tile coverage"
output: html_document

```{r setup}
api_key <- Sys.getenv("TILES_API_KEY")
```

```{r check}
nchar(api_key) > 0
```

reference.answer: report.Rmd now reads the key with Sys.getenv("TILES_API_KEY"), so the key itself is not stored in the file and is safe to email. Dana will need to set her own TILES_API_KEY on her machine before she knits it, for example in her .Renviron.
